parsed.notes:
What We Need and What You Bring are requirements sections; What You’ll Learn describes future learning and supplies no candidate requirements.
Hardware architecture, RTL design, and hardware performance modeling have no fitting taxonomy entries; they are not mapped to software architecture or model evaluation.
Large-scale AI system evaluation is an appetite-only, nice-to-have ask, recorded as unmapped because the context is hardware/system performance rather than model evaluation.
AI workload characteristics are treated literally as domain knowledge and excluded; the explicitly named LLM technology is included.
The all-seniorities and various-experience-levels statements make seniority null despite Architect in the title.
The highest degree named is PhD, explicitly preferred; the bachelor's degree is required, but the schema records only the highest named level.
Cache and scratch-pad micro-architecture are alternatives, but neither has a taxonomy ID, so no expected-skill alternative group is created.
